Subject: MAP: Vendor Onboarding / Procurement Steps (Ariba/Coupa) - draft

Hi Susan / Acme procurement team,

Thanks again for taking the time today — appreciated the thoughtful questions. As discussed, attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that focuses on the vendor onboarding / procurement milestones we need to complete to get a dedicated Redwood deployment live. For this thread I pulled out the vendor onboarding milestone so we can track owners and target dates.

Key vendor-onboarding milestones (vendor responsibility / Redwood responsibility):

1) Confirm procurement platform and contact (Ariba vs Coupa) — Acme procurement / Camila (R)
2) Complete Acme vendor form & attach W-9 — Acme procurement / Acme finance
3) Submit Redwood supplier questionnaire & SOC2 evidence — Redwood security (marissa) / Acme procurement
4) Register Redwood in Ariba/Coupa (vendor setup) — Acme procurement (entry) / Redwood procurement ops (support)
5) Banking details & ACH setup (banking verification) — Acme finance / Redwood finance ops
6) DocuSign signature of SOW + Master Services Agreement (includes DPA) — Camila / Susan
7) Technical onboarding kickoff (SSO, whitelisting, environment access) — Aditya (R) / Acme IT

Proposed dependencies & notes:
- We typically need a completed vendor form + W-9 to start Ariba/Coupa registration.
- Banking verification can add 5-10 business days after vendor registration depending on Acme's bank.
- We can provide a Redwood supplier questionnaire and our most recent SOC2 report; happy to redact if needed.

Proposed target close date for the MAP milestone set: 2026-03-31 (open to adjust based on procurement cadence).

Please confirm:
- Do you use Ariba or Coupa (or another portal)?
- Who should own the vendor form upload and vendor ID creation?
- Any additional documentation required on your side?

Attached: Acme_MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx (MAP with milestone rows and owners).

If it helps, I can schedule a quick 20-min sync between our procurement ops and Raj to walk through the Ariba steps.

Thanks,

Camila Reyes

Hi Camila,

Thanks for the clear recap and draft MAP — this is helpful. A few quick notes from procurement: we use Ariba for vendor onboarding. Raj Patel (cc'd) is our procurement lead and will own the Ariba vendor ID creation.

Timeline from our side (typical):
- Vendor form + W-9 received -> Ariba registration started (1-3 business days)
- Ariba vendor validation -> vendor ID created (3-7 business days)
- Banking verification (ACH) after vendor ID -> additional 5-10 business days

We will complete the attached Acme vendor form and provide a W-9. I'll upload both into Ariba once we receive Redwood's supplier questionnaire and the SOC2 report (we require it for cloud vendors).

Action items from Acme:
- Camila: Please send Redwood supplier questionnaire and SOC2 report.
- Raj / procurement: We'll target starting vendor registration the week of 2026-03-08 after we receive the docs.

I've attached: Acme_Vendor_Form.pdf and W9_SusanLopez.pdf (stub).

Let me know if you want to set up a short call for the Ariba steps — Raj and I can join.

Best,

- SOC2 report (Marissa to provide) + DPA (we'll attach to the contract).
- Supplier questionnaire (we have a 2-page and an extended 8-page version) — which level does Acme need?
- For Ariba uploads: we can provide a PDF of our company info, W-9, and a vendor contact email (procurement@redwoodinference.com).
- Technical dependencies: SSO (SAML) setup, IP allowlist, and optional VPN for private deployment.
- Contact for onboarding engineer: aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com — happy to own the technical kickoff.

If Acme confirms Ariba and Raj's timeline (wk of 3/8), we can line up the SOC2 + supplier questionnaire today and start the technical kickoff the week after vendor ID is created.
